data.body: Decision: a run whose only unsuccessful jobs never got a runner casts the existing no-label 'cancelled' vote-type (Verified stays 0 after clear-vote; the CANCELLED message and triage comment still post). Precedent: d1d4-8c8b-e2c5-4ac2 (commit b45ce2a490a) made cancelled runs comment-only no-vote outcomes; this reuses that path. ADR 0114 governs adding/promoting required gates and is not engaged: no job enters or leaves the Verified aggregate, and the new snapshot step is continue-on-error input to normalize. Root cause: inside the reusable build-and-test workflow a not-acquired matrix cell does not surface as a 'cancelled' needs result, so FAILURE_OBSERVED=false and the normalize CONCLUSION expression fell through to fail-closed 'failure' (all 4 runs logged CONCLUSION=failure FAILURE_OBSERVED=false -> vote-type=failure). Discriminator (jobs API): runner_id 0, runner_name empty, steps []. Survey of the last 200 Gerrit Verified Gate runs: 19 cancelled jobs matched it, 26 cancelled-after-start jobs all had a runner and 25-29 steps. Auto re-queue rejected: needs actions: write in the job holding the Gerrit vote key. Fail-closed: any other failed/cancelled-with-steps job, FAILURE_OBSERVED=true, or a missing/invalid snapshot keeps Verified -1.
